metadata.title: [complex] torch.{sqrt, abs}_ does not match numpy

trigger_conditions.condition: Applying numerical operators to complex tensors with extremely large magnitude values, which may expose precision loss or inaccurate computation in specific dtype implementations.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: Calling torch.sqrt on CPU complex tensors (complex64 or complex128) with large-magnitude real or imaginary components, such as 0-1e20j or -1e20-4988429.2j, causing inaccurate results from the CPU complex sqrt implementation.

failure_behavior.description: Calling torch.sqrt on CPU complex tensors (complex64 or complex128) with large-magnitude real or imaginary components, such as 0-1e20j or -1e20-4988429.2j, causing inaccurate results from the CPU complex sqrt implementation.
